%1$s is turned off. Permission not granted: %2$s.
The call screening role is not available on this phone.
This settings page could not be opened on this phone.

Signing in turns on the natural Indian voice (Polly Kajal) and syncs it to this phone. Calls still work offline: the voice files are downloaded once and stay on the phone. You can skip this and use the on-device voices.
The natural Indian voice is off. Sign in to turn it on. The on-device voice is used until then.
Android lets only the call screening app see incoming calls before they ring. Call Answer needs this role to check who is calling and to answer unknown callers for you.
Call Answer compares each caller with your contacts. Callers in your contacts keep ringing for you. Without this, no call is answered by %1$s.
Call Answer answers unknown callers on your behalf and ends the call when %1$s is done. It also reads the phone state to see when a call starts and ends.
Answer phone calls and phone state (ANSWER_PHONE_CALLS, READ_PHONE_STATE)
Call Answer listens to the caller to understand what they want. Audio is processed on the phone and is not saved by the App.
Call Answer shows an alert when a caller needs you, a live call notification with Take over and End call, and a prompt to report spam after a call.

Call Answer texts your location link to a delivery caller who asks for directions. If you turn it on, it can also send spam reports to 1909 without opening your messaging app. Reports are sent only to 1909 (TRAI).
Map location text and silent spam reports
When a caller needs you, Call Answer shows its alert on top of the lock screen. On Android 14 and later this needs full-screen notification access.

This lets the Agent start when a call comes in. Android blocks apps that are not on screen from starting call handling, so Call Answer shows a small bar, \"Call Answer is handling this call\", while it answers and for as long as the call lasts. Some banking and UPI apps warn when another app is displayed over them; the bar disappears when the call ends.
Starting the Agent when a call comes in
Android can stop background apps to save battery. Call Answer must keep running during a call, so it needs unrestricted battery use.
Allow the app in the list that opens. On Samsung phones also open App info, then Battery, and choose Unrestricted, and remove Call Answer from Never sleeping apps limits.

Your phone\'s own call recorder saves recordings. Choose the folder where it saves them and Call Answer will link each recording to its call log entry. The App reads only this folder and never copies files.
Pick the call recordings folder in the system picker. The App asks for access to that folder only, not to all your files.
Linking recordings to the call log
Call Answer cannot start your phone\'s call recorder. Open the Phone app, go to Settings, then Record calls, and turn on auto record for unknown numbers. You only need to do this once.
Auto record in the Phone app
Screening is on. Unknown callers are answered by %1$s.
Screening is off in settings. Calls ring as usual.
Screening is not active. Call Answer is not set as the call screening app.
Screening is not active. Contacts permission is missing, so calls ring for you.
No recordings folder is selected, so recordings cannot be linked to the call log. Choose one below.
